title: Portuguese Dumplings with Yoghurt Sauce
description: A refreshing twist on traditional Portuguese dumplings, served with a tangy yoghurt sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Add the Portuguese dumplings and cook according to package instructions (usually 5-7 minutes).
Drain the dumplings and set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together the yoghurt and effervescent water.
Season the yoghurt sauce with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the cooked dumplings with the yoghurt sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
